name: Evaluation Metrics for 3D Reconstruction
definition: Computes geometric accuracy, completeness, photometric precision/recall, F-score, normal consistency, and PSNR to evaluate neural scene reconstruction quality.
summary: Evaluation Metrics for 3D Reconstruction quantify geometric, photometric, and procedural quality using point-cloud distances and SLAM trajectory errors, distinguishing itself from mesh quality evaluation by focusing on point-cloud-based geometric distances and SLAM-specific trajectory errors.
